• solve partial anagrams, when you know that some of the letters of an answer are an anagram, but other letters are unknown. 
• solve subset anagrams, when you want to find the longest word you can make from a given set of letters.
• search with multiple possibilities for letters, when you know a letter is one of a few possibilities, but not which one it is.
• search with letter variables, when you know that several letters are the same, but not which letter it is.
• search with vowel and consonant symbols, when you know that a letter is either a vowel or a consonant, but not which letter it is.
